features.title: What does the platform help you learn?

plan.title: Create Learning Plan
plan.description: Choose a programming language, set goals, and AI will create a learning path suited to your level.

goal.title: Set Learning Goals
goal.description: Set specific goals: Frontend, Backend, Full-stack, Mobile,... and track your achievement.

track.title: Track Progress
track.description: View progress through each chapter and lesson. Personal dashboard shows your learning overview.

lesson.title: Detailed Lesson Content
lesson.description: Each lesson includes theory, code examples, common mistakes, and practice exercises.

ai.title: AI-Generated Content
ai.description: Lesson content is AI-generated based on your goals and level, ensuring the best fit.

step1.title: Choose a language
step1.desc: JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, Go,... choose the language you want to learn or improve.

step2.title: Set your goal

step4.title: Learn the roadmap
step4.desc: AI creates chapters → lessons → code examples. Track progress on dashboard.
